title: Text: DET Steve Liddle ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Doing well man, how you doing?  Just waiting for this “spring training” to begin.  I believe the next three weeks will give the clubs a working model of how they plan to mitigate or work around this pandemic.  The strategy behind this season is different from any other ever played in the history of the game.  Front offices and field personnel will have to adapt and improvise to a whole new set of parameters.  It’s like I mentioned to Gardy, this season is a sprint, not a marathon like we usually play. Teams that can do a better job of getting their guys ready and staying healthy, virus free, will find themselves in the thick of things after the first few weeks of the season.  Definitely going to be interesting for sure.

I’m doing good, glad to talk baseball again. I know everybody wants to play 162 and the process has been frustrating and there is a pandemic going on, but I think the Tigers should be thrilled with the way things have worked out. I am happy for the staff because I think they are in a very good spot - after these two years, they deserve to coach a competitive team and I think they will ... Next year! I don’t know if they would have gotten (or wanted) that opportunity with another season of 100 losses. It takes its toll. ...
Everything is good here, ready to get off the couch. I haven’t missed baseball as much as I expected, but I have missed working and talking to people. How is Anne doing?

She is doing well Buddy.  Her blood counts are slightly low in every area but her doctor thinks this is the post chemo model we will deal with for the rest of her life. This is a Big year for her.  We need for her to remain clean so that her odds for reoccurrence will start diminishing.  Appreciate you thinking of her.  Anne said, it’s a good thing I’m home so I won’t have to memorize the 120 page COVID 19 handbook.
I know. Or the new rules of baseball
